Profiles.Name: ClaudeLauncher
Profiles.Description: Session profile for claude-launcher tabs. Glass background, bell-driven macOS notifications, resizable so the launcher can tile it.

Profiles.Name: ClaudeLauncher Mirror
Profiles.Description: Overview-desktop profile. Window Type is NORMAL (0), NOT born-fullscreen: the launcher creates this window, does all its structural work (splits, sentinel tagging, pane labels) while the window is a stable normal window, and only THEN toggles it into native macOS fullscreen via System Events so macOS gives it its own Space. Born-fullscreen (Window Type 12) was abandoned because the window animates onto its own Space at creation time, and session/window refs are unstable during that animation — splitting and sentinel-tagging silently failed, so the singleton could never be found again and every launch spawned a new overview window. Bell notifications are OFF here: the mirror panes echo sessions that already notify from their own tab, so leaving this on would double every notification.
